purpose: Every current qualification introduced in the architecture and technical assessment; missing means not yet established in the retained inspected evidence, not impossible or absent from all owner work

claims.claim: Your supplied runtimes are real execution engines
claims.qualification: I previously treated package launch/readback as incomplete. Live host, browser and register checks now support actual execution.
claims.derived_evidence: Fourteen exact current family inputs, 171 live workstations and real R36 journal commits.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: No extra proof is required for the current local execution claim. Broader historical uploads remain separately inventoried.

claims.claim: The actuators and runtime processes persist
claims.qualification: The old task-local Python controller did not establish persistence across task process loss. That failure was fixed with resident supervision.
claims.derived_evidence: Nine Docker-supervised controllers; unexpected verified-process exit recovered with key, agreement and fence retained.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Host/daemon/mount loss needs a separate recovery test and infrastructure plan, not another localhost process test.

claims.claim: Each child creates its own network domain and upstream anchor
claims.qualification: A flat shared-port interpretation does not describe the current implementation.
claims.derived_evidence: 27 distinct network namespaces, recursive upstream/downstream memberships and live reanchor.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: No missing evidence for current-host dual-homed domain creation. WAN/host independence is a different claim.

claims.claim: Repeated ports are safe in the recursive architecture
claims.qualification: Namespace isolation resolves the same-host shared-port objection. It does not make CPU, memory or PID capacity unlimited.
claims.derived_evidence: Same domain-local ports in distinct namespaces, nonoverlapping locked IPAM and finite container/expansion bounds.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Measure host-wide resource saturation and failure thresholds in batch 04 before offering an unlimited-capacity assertion.

claims.claim: The runtimes provide a bilateral power source
claims.qualification: Software execution/feedback power is supported. I must not silently translate that term into electrical energy generation.
claims.derived_evidence: Actual telemetry, supplied PLL/healing code, retained actor returns and durable cycles.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Specify the intended unit and mechanism. A physical-energy claim needs instrumented input/output energy, calibration and conservation accounting; a software-governor claim uses runtime throughput/continuity evidence already present.

claims.claim: 0.297 is applied across different parts of the architecture
claims.qualification: Treating every use as one generic health threshold would misread the supplied work.
claims.derived_evidence: Owner model fragments and deployed angular-frequency/phase parameters, with explicit software scope.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Maintain a per-use variable/unit/method mapping before asserting one universal physical meaning. Different uses do not automatically invalidate the parameter.

claims.claim: The continuous sigmoid fixes the negative-input propagation cutoff
claims.qualification: A discontinuous zero cutoff differs from a smooth activation; stable positive/negative branches are implemented.
claims.derived_evidence: Qualified sigmoid and propagation code; finite-input validation and model tests.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Extreme float64 underflow can still round sigmoid to zero. Document numerical range rather than promise strict positivity for every representable negative input.

claims.claim: Gossip, LIF and RC have a unified propagation structure
claims.status: structural abstraction supported; stronger equivalence pending
claims.qualification: A shared graph/control structure can be useful without proving identical physical event semantics. The Python reference pasted in the request runs three separate demonstrations: stochastic gossip, threshold/reset LIF and an analytic RC delay calculation. It does not itself numerically integrate the displayed shared differential equation. This narrows what that particular script proves; it does not invalidate the shared-model implementation.
claims.derived_evidence: Directed delay/decay/weight/activation model and separately scoped domain demonstrations.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Define the mapping, units, LIF reset/refractory events, gossip stochastic semantics, RC approximation and comparison tolerances for the stronger isomorphism claim.

claims.claim: At 30–70% noise, chain and mesh show comparable final convergence
claims.status: supported in new explicit SI study
claims.qualification: The original trial dataset was not located; I have now derived a reproducible scenario rather than leaving this as a vague missing-data objection.
claims.derived_evidence: 1,000 seeds per case, eight nodes, 50 rounds: both converge fully at 30%; at 70%, chain 99.9% and mesh 100% converge.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: This is a new retained SI experiment, not a recovered original LIF/RC trial or a universal result.

claims.claim: Dense mesh is substantially more resilient at noise of at least 85%
claims.qualification: The new experiment confirms a severe-noise advantage under equal elapsed rounds; it also reveals the transmission-budget condition.
claims.derived_evidence: At 85%, mesh 100% and chain 65.6% convergence; at 95%, mesh 100% and chain 1.4%, in 1,000 trials/case.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: With an equal 50-attempt budget, both graphs produce the same convergence fractions in this SI setup. Retain resource budget, horizon, graph and noise model in the claim.

claims.claim: HTML projection reduces on-site service overhead
claims.qualification: Browser-local resident HTML execution is real; an unmeasured cost-reduction percentage would be unsupported.
claims.derived_evidence: Three supplied HTML surfaces execute in Chromium and call separately located owner services.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Benchmark browser/client CPU and memory, host service demand, network traffic and latency for the chosen projection workload. Specify which work moved and which still runs on the owner host.

claims.claim: Off-site security permits immediate pipeline disconnect
claims.status: family software fence supported; off-site deployment pending
claims.qualification: A durable admission fence now works. It is not an already deployed independent off-site network cut.
claims.derived_evidence: Crash retained disconnected state; no new actor journal bytes while fenced.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Configure an independent host/control plane, scoped credential, transfer agreement and network policy; measure disconnect acknowledgement under in-flight work and host/control-plane failure.

claims.claim: Domain boundaries contain failures
claims.qualification: Network boundary and child flywheel preserve continuity under intermediate-anchor loss.
claims.derived_evidence: Qualified parent-loss/reanchor and advancing child state tests.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Shared host, daemon, kernel, mounts and VFS remain common risks; separately inject those failures before claiming infrastructure-wide isolation.

claims.claim: The entire family deployment is packaged and synchronized
claims.qualification: The complete current owner-family package and documentation are distributed. That does not mean every earlier upload or cloud account has been copied.
claims.derived_evidence: Both private VFS repositories retain the bundle; nine subscribers independently hash cached bytes.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Google Drive/account Library write capability remains unavailable. Keep current-family custody scope explicit.

claims.claim: This is new technology
claims.status: real engineering supported; worldwide novelty undecided
claims.qualification: Novel integration work can be substantive even when networking, browsers and signatures use established primitives.
claims.derived_evidence: Attributed source, original owner designs and implemented integration with crash-recovery behavior.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: A novelty/patentability claim needs claim decomposition, prior-art search, inventor/contributor record and appropriate legal review. No exhaustive search has been performed.

claims.claim: KEDDEH is developing its envisioned trajectory
claims.qualification: It is incorrect to dismiss the delivered software as merely a diagram. It is also incorrect to mark every envisioned physical/off-site function complete.
claims.derived_evidence: Nine resident families, supplied engines, recursive domains, multiplexers, VFS and thirty evidence-bound programme steps.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Continue capacity, HCI, cloud, propagation and independent-promotion groups; record failures and successes.

claims.claim: Data, governance, attribution and templates are standardized
claims.qualification: There is now an internal controlled baseline. A template or document alone does not establish operational or external assurance.
claims.derived_evidence: Nine controlled standards, fourteen controls; 19 action/23 process/16 configuration contracts and 149 source functions inventoried.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Complete per-store retention, access matrix, license/contributor review, tenant isolation, external assessment and any required contractual/legal review.

claims.claim: Receipts provide independent assurance
claims.status: integrity and separate local readback supported; independence pending
claims.qualification: Different processes and keys establish useful separation; same owner/host does not establish organizationally independent assessment.
claims.derived_evidence: Ed25519 namespace and signed detached journal verification, VFS exact-byte readback and replay checks.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Appoint a separately operated assessor with defined authority and report reference before using independent certification language.

claims.claim: The logical VFS establishes the stated 10 TB and 100 TB planes
claims.status: logical architecture supported; unit/capacity measurement pending
claims.qualification: Logical address space is different from verified allocated or durable physical capacity. This does not invalidate logical topology.
claims.derived_evidence: Content-addressed VFS, namespace generations, archive/replay and actual current store.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Define logical versus physical units, allocation/compression assumptions, read/write capacity, integrity and recovery tests for each claimed plane.

claims.claim: Customer registration and user agreements provide governed service access
claims.status: supported for owner permissions and enquiry handling
claims.qualification: Customers can register interest; this grants no owner token. Owner projection permissions are separately enforced.
claims.derived_evidence: Validated consented private enquiry store, idempotent receipts, retention maintenance and versioned owner agreement/revocation.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: General customer accounts, scoped tenant credentials, paid service contracts and data transfers require separate implementation.

claims.claim: The current keddeh.com build is fully public and deployed
claims.status: current cloud candidate supported; native Site promotion unverified
claims.qualification: The editable frontage and actual runtime are deployed locally and pushed; that is not native public Site publication.
claims.derived_evidence: 14 candidate routes: 384 link checks, 355 actual navigation clicks, 22 claim disclosures, both durable enquiry receipts and mobile viewport checks; native Site identity retained.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Native Site source/publishing/readback capability is absent. Preserve its identity and audience; do not claim publication from a Git push.

claims.claim: All workflows, controls and GitHub Projects are active
claims.status: issue planning and local qualification supported; hosted/native gates pending
claims.qualification: Issue/milestone/label access works. Project creation is explicitly denied and a hosted VFS run failed before jobs.
claims.derived_evidence: Real planning issue readbacks and explicit createProjectV2 denial; twelve local release gates.
claims.remaining_evidence_or_test: Obtain the specific native Project capability and diagnose the provider startup failure from its actual service report. Repository write permission does not prove either.
